entities.summary: Muratbek Sansyzbayevich Imanaliyev is a Kyrgyz politician who served as the foreign minister of Kyrgyzstan from 1991 to 1992 and from 1 July 1997 to 2002. He was also the secretary-general of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation from 2010 to 2012.
